# French Vanilla Theme Overrider
Bonjour and Hello. This is a Vanilla Theme Overrider that turns Vanilla Signs and Roadmarkings to French ones. This Overrider uses the Caracteres L1 Font. Can be found [here](https://de.ffonts.net/Caracteres-L1.font?text=00000das1).
---
## Requirements - [Write Everywhere](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/92908/Windows) – required
---
